description: Search promotional offers (discounts and promo codes) across prop firms — defaults to live (active, unexpired) offers only. propfirmId narrows to one firm; challengeId resolves the offers that apply to a challenge (firm-wide offers included). Every offer carries the promo code, discount, end date, and affiliate link.

challengeId.description: Public challenge ids; an offer matches when it applies to at least one (all-challenges offers match that firm's challenges)

direction.description: Sort direction; each sort key has a sensible default

discountIsPercent.description: true for percent discounts, false for absolute amounts

includeExpired.description: When true, ended offers are not hidden (default false)

includeInactive.description: When true, inactive offers are not hidden (default false)

isActive.description: Defaults to live offers only; pass false to look at inactive offers

offerText.description: Case-insensitive search over promo code and offer descriptions

promoCode.description: Case-insensitive substring of the promo code

sort.description: Sort key (default: featured first, then discount)

text.description: Case-insensitive search over promo code, descriptions, and firm name/slug

name: propfirms_search_offers
title: Search prop-firm offers
